page.overview:
Who is Isotope?

Lieutenant of Machine Head Lieutenant of Titan

Isotope is a minor antagonist in Invincible, debuting from Season 1 and onwards. He was Machine Head's top lieutenant before becoming Titan's right-hand man.

Isotope is a Caucasian male with green hair tied back and a goatee. He wears a black shirt with a white "I" logo representing his name along with a violet business suit.

Isotope has shown loyalty to those who gain his respect, which is why he aligned with Titan instead of his previous employer, Machine Head, assisting the former in seizing control of Machine Head's criminal empire. Although he lacked formal education, he understood how to navigate the criminal underworld and consistently did his utmost to survive, particularly when confronted by The Order.
